narrative_purpose: Anchors the cold open: the same atmosphere entering two chests a few metres apart, one of which needs a machine to survive it. Establishes that the difference is internal, not respiratory.
subject: Two figures standing about three metres apart in a forest clearing, both in three-quarter view and both at ease. On the right a tall slender blue-skinned humanoid, face entirely bare, ribs visibly relaxed mid-breath, condensed mist on its skin and forearms. On the left a human in plain field clothing wearing a close-fitting transparent breathing shell across nose and mouth, a small cylindrical filter cartridge seated at the jawline with one faint indicator light. Drifting glowing spores hang in the air in the space between them.
scene: A clearing on the floor of a tall bioluminescent forest, saturated air visible as thick low haze, glowing fronds and fungal growth lighting the ground, enormous dark trunks receding behind.
camera: Medium-wide eye-level shot holding both figures and the air between them in frame.
light: Cool bioluminescent key rising from the glowing ground growth, catching the undersides of both faces; one small ember point on the human's filter cartridge; deep indigo ambient shadow through the trunks.
palette: Void-indigo and deep teal-indigo dominant, cyan and living-teal glow from the understorey, a single scarce amber point at the filter unit.
style: Painterly naturalist field-observation plate, oil texture, observed rather than staged.
detail_level: Crisp on both figures, on the breathing shell and its cartridge, and on the suspended spores between them; the forest behind soft; the far trunks dissolving into haze.
composition: Two figures set apart across the frame with the hazy air between them as the centre of interest, dark quiet space above, low glowing growth anchoring the bottom edge.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette, bioluminescent key from the forest. The blue humanoid is tall and slender with large eyes, a long tail and four limbs; the human is ordinary proportion with a transparent partial-face breathing shell, never an opaque helmet. Keep a plain dark region beside each figure for overlaid callouts.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no cartoon or anime style
